execution_dependencies: T4 complete final DECISION/MANIFEST, INTERVENTIONS and BASELINE_CHECKS. All10 events POWER1/SKIP/D1/D2/D3/D5/D6 successful with scorer<=1e-9 and baseline parity. D4 either successful or explicit preserved D4 NONSPD error per event; no repair required. Any F1 verdict allowed. Genuine baseline/scorer/other errors and incomplete events block. D4 NONSPD does not require every intervention TECHNICAL_PASS.
label: ORACLE_OFFLINE_TRAINING_LABEL: same saved POWER prior x/P; change only current packet action among POWER,R0,INFLATE4,SKIP; every subsequent packet original POWER. Heading mean squared error over (current_t,current_t+10s], degrees squared. Utility(action)=MSE_POWER-MSE_action, POWER=0. Action targets continuous; signs also reported.
training_packets: Old7 B0 seed0 only. Greedy chronological actual RF samples t>=30, next selected time>=last selected+5s, full 10s future available. Selection fixed without GT error, gate, feature outcome, or label.
strict_nested_folds: Outer policy held route R2/R4/R5 omitted from every training feature/label/P1 fit. For each inner training route, P1 priors from start use ScalarPower trained only remaining old routes excluding BOTH outer route and inner route and identical sites within1e-4m of the entire inner route. Same source labels/site_weights/fitter; cached features avoid RF recomputation. ALL_OLD model for new-route evaluation uses normal inner-route-heldout P1 priors across all old routes. Outer evaluation uses historical original OOF POWER baseline. Training label generation uses no new9 labels.
features: Exactly restored features.FEATURES (17 measured Full-only features) plus POWER candidate NIS, prior heading sigma radians, P_psi_bg radians^2/s, H_spsi per radian. No GT, NativeLoS H, evaluation coordinates, future, case/route identifiers or labels as features. NativeLoS safety is a separate observed-input control.
action_semantics: POWER unchanged learned mu/C, R0 zero mu/fixedR0, INFLATE4 unchanged POWER mu with C*4, SKIP no update. Original joint 99% gate preserved in non-skip actions; POWER does not force an otherwise rejected update.

learner.selection: argmax predicted utility; exact ties POWER then R0 then INFLATE4 then SKIP; POWER utility target always0; no hyperparameter tuning

evaluation: old7 x B0/L0/L1/L2 Full, new9 x B0/L0/L1/L2 Full (seed0 canonical T2), NativeLoS R2 A M0/M45 x4bias. All motion t>=30; old clock RF only; new RF-only additional comparison. Common11 metrics plus independent scorer. Policy chooses online on its own recursive prior, not historical baseline prior.

verification.model_files: Load only own trained pickles after SHA256 matches MODELS.json

decision: SUPPORTED_BUT_LIMITED only if every16 Full conditions at every4bias has POLICY headingRMSE<=1.10*POWER1 and all NativeLoS R2 A M0/M45 x4bias has POLICY<=1.10*R0. Otherwise NO_GO, scientific NOT_ESTABLISHED. Missing cells/errors do not pass. No target-setting selection after outcomes.
limits: No independent-scene generalization; old/corridor C share scene, office O share scene. No p-values, normalized Bayesian posterior, hardware claim. Offline GT utility labels are not online inference inputs. Preserve negative outcomes and all errors; any change requires new lock/version.

posthoc_validity_20261020.reason_ko: T7B NO_GO는 사전 고정한 v2 정책(특징·label·학습·행동 규칙)의 평가 결과에만 적용한다. 효용 target 접근 전체나 가능한 다른 정책의 기각으로 일반화하지 않는다.
